Title: Mayday
Scenario: You're enjoying a ride in your <watercraft> when all of a sudden, the boat hits an iceberg and begins taking on water.
Log Version: I hit an iceberg while riding in my <watercraft>.

Title: Flame Out
Scenario: You're enjoying the cool wind in your face as you steer your <watercraft> at top speed across open waters, when suddenly something pops, jolting the craft. You look down to discover the engine is engulfed in flames.
Log Version: I was steering my <watercraft> across open waters when the engine burst into flames.

Title: Get Kraken
Scenario: While out enjoying calm seas in your <watercraft>, you suddenly feel the boat jerk hard to the right. You look starboard to discover a massive squid has latched its tentacles to the side of your boat and is pulling it down.
Log Version: A massive squid attacked my <watercraft> and pulled it into the water.

Title: Blimey!
Scenario: While out sailing the seas in your <watercraft>, looking for more booty to pillage, you notice a schooner off in the distance firing a cannon. A few seconds later, your ship is struck by a cannonball, shattering the hull.
Log Version: My <watercraft> was hit by a cannonball when I was out looking for some booty.

Title: Big Wave
Scenario: While piloting your <watercraft> across rough waters, you notice what looks like a tidal wave heading in your direction. Within seconds, the wave crashes upon you, forcing your vessel under.
Log Version: My <watercraft> was forced under water by a massive tidal wave.

Title: Holey Terror
Scenario: While partying like rockstars on the deck of your <watercraft>, you hear a strange noise coming from the water below. You look over the side and discover that an eco-terrorist just drilled a massive hole in your boat.
Log Version: An eco-terrorist drilled a hole in my <watercraft> while I was partying with some friends on the deck the boat.

Title: Direct Hit
Scenario: You're enjoying a sunny afternoon aboard your <watercraft> when out of nowhere, a cruise missile strikes your vessel, shattering the hull of your boat.
Log Version: My <watercraft> was struck by a cruise missle and it shattered the hull.

Title: The Italian Job
Scenario: While steering close to the shore, flexing your <watercraft> at some friends along the beach, you suddenly hear a crunching noise as the vessel strikes rock and begins tipping sideways.
Log Version: I was flexing my <watercraft> at some friends along the shore when it hit rock and tipped sideways.

Title: Mast Exodus
Scenario: You're struggling to navigate your <watercraft> through an intense storm when suddenly a violent wind snaps the mast off your vessel, taking the sails with it.
Log Version: A violent wind snapped the mast off my <watercraft>.

Title: Speed Demon
Scenario: While peacefully cruising in your <watercraft> across calm waters, you notice a speed boat rapidly moving in your direction. As you attempt to outmaneuver the sudden threat, it strikes your vessel, and bursts into flames.
Log Version: I was hit by a speed boat in my <watercraft>, and it burst into flames.

Title: Bad Muse
Scenario: You're steering your <watercraft> across ocean waters when suddenly a Somali pirate enters the bridge with a flamethrower in his hand saying, "I'm the captain now". You instinctively kick him in the groin and the flamethrower discharges, engulfing the control panel in flames.
Log Version: A Somali pirate, armed with a flamethrower, boarded my <watercraft> in the middle of the night and his flamethrower discharged.

Title: Shooting Star
Scenario: While sailing your <watercraft> across calm waters in the dark of night, you observe a shooting star that appears to be heading toward you. Seconds later, a fiery meteorite rips through your boat, blasting a massive hole through the bottom.
Log Version: A meteorite struck my <watercraft> and blew a hole through the bottom of the craft.

Title: Da Bomb
Scenario: While enjoying the ocean with some friends aboard your <watercraft>, you notice what looks like a sea mine just up ahead. You attempt to divert, but it's too late, and the mine detonates, blasting a massive hole in your boat.
Log Version: I struck a sea mine in my <watercraft>, and it blasted a massive hole in my boat.

Title: Midnight Fright
Scenario: Despite adverse weather reports, you decide to take your <watercraft> out for some fun on the ocean late at night. Just as you lose sight of the shore, lightning strikes the engine, and you lose all power.
Log Version: My <watercraft> was struck by lightning and lost all power, including the engine.

Title: Blown Engine
Scenario: You're experimenting with how fast your <watercraft> will go, pushing it as hard as you can, when suddenly the engine explodes, bursting into flames.
Log Version: I was testing the top speed of my <watercraft> when the engine exploded and burst into flames.

Title: White Squall
Scenario: You're battling a violent storm at sea aboard your <watercraft> when you notice a colossal wave heading in your direction. Next thing you know, your boat quickly rises, then flips on its side.
Log Version: While battling a storm in my <watercraft>, a colossal wave hit and flipped my boat on its side.

Title: Sinking Sub
Scenario: You decide to explore an ocean trench in your <watercraft> when suddenly the ballast tank blows out, and the vessel uncontrollably begins to sink.
Log Version: I was exploring an ocean trench in my <watercraft> when suddenly the ballast tank blew out, and the vessel sank.

Title: Party Down
Scenario: While throwing a mad rave for some friends aboard your <watercraft>, you suddenly realize that a certain repetitive techno beat is actually the sonar warning signal. Within seconds you strike rock and begin sinking.
Log Version: I mistook a warning signal for a techno beat while raving with some friends aboard my <watercraft>, and we hit rock and sunk.

Title: Hot Lunch
Scenario: While relaxing with friends on the deck of your <watercraft>, waiting for lunch to be served, you're informed that the chef accidentally started a grease fire while deep-frying fish n' chips, and the galley is ablaze.
Log Version: A chef accidentally started a galley fire while deep-frying fish n' chips aboard my <watercraft>.

Title: Crushed Ice
Scenario: While having fun smashing through the ice in your <watercraft>, you inadvertently break loose part of a glacier that crashes onto the rear of your boat, splitting off the propeller.
Log Version: While smashing through ice in my <watercraft>, I inadvertently broke loose a chunk of glacier that fell on my boat and split off the propeller.

Title: Revenge of the Birds
Scenario: You're out hunting birds on a lake in your <watercraft> when a sudden wind knocks you off balance. While attempting to correct yourself, the shotgun accidentally fires, blasting a hole in the bottom of your boat.
Log Version: While hunting birds on a lake, I accidentally blasted a hole in the bottom of my <watercraft> with a shotgun.
